save_checkpoint_model: save a model checkpoint with optimizer and RNG states to disk for later resumption
load_checkpoint_model: load a model checkpoint from disk restoring model optimizer and RNG states
move_weights_gpt2: move weights from a HuggingFace GPT-2 model to a Megatron model via in-place copy
print_params_min_max_norm: print the min max and norm of all parameters in the optimizer for debugging
Timers_class: create a group of timers to measure and log elapsed time for training operations
